reason: Stem had no question and misquoted Art. III Sec. 1 (missing 'shall'); C/D were not parts of the Constitution, replaced with real articles

fields.text: The provision "No person shall be deprived of life, liberty, or property without due process of law, nor shall any person be denied the equal protection of the laws" is found in which part of the 1987 Constitution?
fields.optionA: Article II, Declaration of Principles and State Policies
fields.optionD: Article XIII, Social Justice and Human Rights
fields.explanation: The due process and equal protection clause is Article III, Section 1 of the 1987 Constitution, the first section of the Bill of Rights.
fields.hint: Due process and equal protection are individual rights protected against the State.
fields.whyA: Article II lists state principles and policies, not enforceable individual rights like due process.
fields.whyC: Article VI deals with Congress and its powers, not individual rights.
fields.whyD: Article XIII covers social justice and the Commission on Human Rights, not the due process clause.
fields.explanationTl: Ang due process at equal protection clause ay nasa Article III, Section 1 ng 1987 Constitution, yung pinaka-unang section ng Bill of Rights.
fields.hintTl: Ang due process at equal protection ay mga karapatan ng bawat tao laban sa State. Saang article nakalista ang mga rights natin?

fields.text: What is the longest river in Africa?
fields.explanation: The Nile, about 6,650 km long, is the longest river in Africa; it flows north through northeastern Africa and empties into the Mediterranean Sea through Egypt.
fields.hint: This river flows through Egypt and was the lifeline of the ancient Egyptians.
fields.whyA: The Congo is Africa's second-longest river and the deepest, but shorter than the Nile.
fields.whyC: The Niger is West Africa's main river, clearly shorter than the Nile.
fields.whyD: The Zambezi, home of Victoria Falls, is much shorter than the Nile.
fields.explanationTl: Ang Nile, mga 6,650 km ang haba, ang pinakamahabang ilog sa Africa. Dumadaloy ito pa-north hanggang Egypt at lumalabas sa Mediterranean Sea.
fields.hintTl: Dumadaan ito sa Egypt, at dito umasa ang mga sinaunang Egyptian.

fields.explanation: The Great Wall of China is a series of fortifications built across northern China over many dynasties to defend against invasions from the north.
fields.hint: It was built over many dynasties, including the Qin and the Ming.

fields.whyC: India is known for the Taj Mahal, not the Great Wall.
fields.whyD: Korea had its own fortresses, but the Great Wall is in China.
fields.explanationTl: Ang Great Wall of China ay mga pader at fortifications sa northern China na ginawa ng iba't ibang dynasty para depensahan ang bansa laban sa mga mananakop mula sa north.
fields.hintTl: Ginawa ito sa loob ng maraming dynasty, kasama ang Qin at Ming.
